notes.subject: ברד / ברדת
notes.rationale: paronomasia: barad (kapetla) le beredet (ho theoha) — modumo o tshwanang, o latlhahile ka Sesotho

notes.subject: בשפלה / תשפל
notes.rationale: paronomasia: shefela (sefahleho-hodimo) le tishpol (e theoha) — motsotso o tshwanang oa motso, o latlhahile

notes.subject: ha sefaha se wa
notes.rationale: diphopholetso di fapana: 'downfall of the forest' (KJV) vs 'hail levels the forest' (BSB) vs 'city descends into the valley' (JPS)

translation: Mme go tla na le kapetla ha sefaha se wa, mme sefahleho-hodimo sa toropo se tla theoha se ea tlase.

tokens.gloss: mme go tla na le kapetla
